# Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Build/CI
- [ ] Test
- [ ] Production hardening
- [ ] Architecture proposal

## Checklist

- [ ] Architecture unchanged, or an approved ADR/architecture issue is linked
- [ ] Public API is not broken
- [ ] Factory, registry, adapter, SDK wrapper, and `Result` contracts are preserved
- [ ] No vendor SDK headers leak outside SDK wrapper implementation files
- [ ] No new runtime feature was added unintentionally
- [ ] Tests passed locally
- [ ] CI passed
- [ ] Documentation updated
- [ ] No new compiler warnings
- [ ] Static-analysis impact reviewed
- [ ] Physical robot command paths were not run, or hardware validation is documented
